page.layout: One centred title page: a title block, a subtitle block, the author and work lines, the Index note, the privilege line and the imprint. The library stamp and round seal are not printed text.

main_text.l: Iurisc. Liber[?]: in quo L. Gallus,
L. Lecta, L. Filius quem, L. Frater à fratre, & aliæ complures

page.notes: Library stamp (oval, "BIBLIOTECA NAZIONALE ROMA VITTORIO EMANUELE") and round seal device on the right: not transcribed. Handwritten marks at top left and right, and a handwritten "1" top right: not transcribed. Stain over the "IVRIS" line, so the S is doubtful; the line reads "IVRI[?]S IN-" with the S obscured. Stain over the start of "interpretandi:" where "in" is faded; read as "terpretandi:" with a doubtful "in". Faded area of "HOTOMANI" and "Liber" is doubtful as marked. Show-through from the reverse faintly visible.
